command.inverse_fn: Compute the inverse function by solving y = f(var) for var.
command.apply_identity: Apply the named algebraic identity to the expression.
command.total_diff: Total derivative applying the chain rule over all declared dependencies.
command.divergence: Divergence of a vector field: sum of partial derivatives ∂Fᵢ/∂xᵢ.
command.laplacian: Laplacian of a scalar field: sum of second partial derivatives ∂²f/∂xᵢ².
command.taylor: Taylor expansion of {expr} in {var} around {center} to order {order}.
command.laurent: Laurent expansion of {expr} in {var} around {center} to order {order}.
command.asymptotic: Asymptotic expansion of {expr} as {var} → ∞ to order {order}.
command.revert: Lagrange reversion of the Taylor series of {expr} in {var} to order {order}.
command.residue: Compute the residue of {expr} at {point} in {var}.
command.optimize: Constrained optimisation is not yet wired into the dispatcher.
command.lagrange_mult: Lagrange-multiplier specialisation is not yet wired into the dispatcher.
command.factor.partial: Full factoring engine is not yet wired into the API; result is the canonical simplification.
command.rearrange: Rearrange equation to isolate the named variable.
command.solve_system: Simultaneous solution of a system of equations.
